title.zh: U.S. September Payrolls Miss Sharply at 29K as Unemployment Rises to 4.2%
title.en: U.S. September Payrolls Miss Sharply at 29K as Unemployment Rises to 4.2%

current_state.zh: U.S. September nonfarm payrolls rose only 29,000 against a 90,000 forecast while unemployment climbed to 4.2%, with July and August revised down by a combined 60,000, signaling a broad cooling in U.S. labor-market momentum.
current_state.en: U.S. September nonfarm payrolls rose only 29,000 against a 90,000 forecast while unemployment climbed to 4.2%, with July and August revised down by a combined 60,000, signaling a broad cooling in U.S. labor-market momentum.
